6.288 rsInvalidTextAlign
Applies to RDL 2003/10 and RDL 2005/01
rsInvalidTextAlign is a critical error that occurs when a Style.TextAlign element is set to a constant
String ([XMLSCHEMA2/2] section 3.2.1) that is not one of its valid values.
